reason: The agent implements both parts of the issue (configurable delay via a new quiz_statistics setting, and de-bounce through reschedule_or_queue_adhoc_task with the DI clock). The hidden recalculate_test fails on names/signatures the issue never specifies: it sets 'recalculatedebounce' (agent used 'recalculatedelay'), calls queue_future_run($quizid, $now) with a second bool argument (agent's signature has one argument, so the $now=true cases expect delay 0 but get HOURSECS), calls a new static task_due_in() that the agent never created (PHP error), and expects 'debounce=0 queues no task', a developer choice not in the issue. The agent did not move the 'Recalculate now' button to an adhoc task, which the issue mentions only as a side note, so it is not a defect that would fail regardless of tests.

The agent updates oauth2_server_client_secrets.lastaccessed in client_repository::validateClient (the hidden client_repository_test now passes) and updates oauth2_server_clients.lastaccessed in the route layer after a successful token exchange, authorize and revoke, which is the behaviour the issue asks for. The two failures are in access_token_repository_test::test_persist_new_access_token, which asserts that persistNewAccessToken() itself writes the client's lastaccessed (and resolves the repository via core\di with an injected clock); the agent chose to record client access in core\route\oauth2 instead, so that repository-level assertion fails even though the client timestamp is written on the same flows. Where the write lives is an implementation choice not stated in the issue.

The issue says the legend contains 'Question N Answer' instead of the question text, so the agent put the formatted question text inside the visually hidden legend, which makes screen readers announce the question as the group label. The developers instead gave the qtext div an id ($qa->get_qt_field_name('qtext')) and added aria-describedby on the fieldset; the hidden test asserts getElementById($questiontextid) is non-null and fieldset aria-describedby equals it, which the agent's output lacks. The second failure is the pre-existing showstandardinstruction test expecting legend text get_string('answer'), which the agent's change (but not the developers') alters. Both are reasonable readings of an issue that specifies the symptom, not the mechanism, though duplicating the question text in a legend is arguably weaker a11y.

The agent adds a working mod_forum_set_read_state service (postid, targetstate) that validates context, checks can_manually_control_post_read_status and calls forum_tp_add_read_record/forum_tp_delete_read_records, and even fixes a real parameter bug in forum_tp_add_read_record. It implements it as mod_forum_external::set_read_state in externallib.php, while the hidden test calls the new class mod_forum\external\set_read_state::execute(), which does not exist (2 errors). The test also expects a return of ['status','warnings'] with warningcode 'cannotcontrolreadstatus' when manual marking is off, whereas the agent throws a moodle_exception and returns the exported post; neither the class location nor the return/warning shape is specified in the issue.

The issue's expected result is that a stale cmid is ignored with no PHP warnings, and says deletion of the stale row is 'ideally'/'could also' be done; the agent applied exactly the early-continue suggested in the issue, which removes the warnings (the agent run shows no PHPUnit warnings). The hidden test additionally asserts assertFalse($DB->record_exists('block_recentlyaccesseditems', ['id' => $staleitemid])), i.e. that get_recent_items() deletes the orphaned row, which the developers chose to do (plus an upgrade step). The agent chose the other behaviour the issue explicitly allowed.

The agent's duration.php changes are functionally identical to the developers': exportValue() falls back with $valuearray['number'] ?? 0 and $valuearray['timeunit'] ?? $this->_options['defaultunit'], and the constructor throws coding_exception when defaultunit is not in the restricted units (it also fixes repository_recent with defaultunit => DAYSECS). The two hidden failures are test_constructor_rejects_defaultunit_not_in_units and test_constructor_rejects_class_default_not_in_units, which use expectExceptionMessageMatches('~is not one of the units allowed~'); the agent's message reads 'must be one of the units specified in the units option', so only the exception string differs. The exportValue tests pass under the agent patch (53 assertions).
